verses.sloka: इति ब्रुवाणम् सुग्रीवम् रामो धर्मभृताम् वरः ।बाहुभ्याम् संपरिष्वज्य प्रत्युवाच कृतांजलिम् ॥४-३९-१॥
verses.transliteration: iti bruvāṇam sugrīvam rāmo dharmabhṛtām varaḥ ।bāhubhyām saṁpariṣvajya pratyuvāca kṛtāṁjalim ॥4-39-1॥

translations.english: On hearing Sugriva who stood with folded hands, Rama, the foremost among the upholders of righteousness, hugged him and said:
translations.hindi: वाहुभ्यां सम्परिष्वञ्य प्रत्युवाच कृताञ्जलिम्‌

verses.sloka: यत् इन्द्रो वर्षते वर्षम् न तत् चित्रम् भविष्यति ।आदित्यो असौ सहस्रांशुः कुर्यात् वितिमिरम् नभः ॥४-३९-२॥
verses.transliteration: yat indro varṣate varṣam na tat citram bhaviṣyati ।ādityo asau sahasrāṁśuḥ kuryāt vitimiram nabhaḥ ॥4-39-2॥

translations.english: 'O scorcher of enemies, gentle Sugriva it will not be strange if Indra showers rain, if the Sun in the sky dispels darkness with his thousand rays, and if the Moon cools down the earth with his light, and a person like you helps his friend.
translations.hindi: बदि देवराज इन्द्र जल की वर्षा करें, अथवा सहस्र किरण : बाले सूये आकारा के अन्धकार को नष्ट कर, उसे वो चे कोई आश्वये की बातें नहीं हैं

verses.sloka: चन्द्रमा रजनीम् कुर्यात् प्रभया सौम्य निर्मलाम् ।त्वत् विधो वा अपि मित्राणाम् प्रीतिम् कुर्यात् परंतप ॥४-३९-३॥
verses.transliteration: candramā rajanīm kuryāt prabhayā saumya nirmalām ।tvat vidho vā api mitrāṇām prītim kuryāt paraṁtapa ॥4-39-3॥

translations.english: 'O scorcher of enemies, gentle Sugriva it will not be strange if Indra showers rain, if the Sun in the sky dispels darkness with his thousand rays, and if the Moon cools down the earth with his light, and a person like you helps his friend.
translations.hindi: यह भी कोई विस्मयोत्पादिनो वात नहीं कि, चन्द्रमा अपनी बिमल किरणों से प्रथिवी को सुन्दर शोभायुक्त कर दें । इसी प्रकार तुम जैसे सत्पुरुष यदि अपने मित्रों का प्रत्युपकार कर इन्द्र सूयं, चन्द्रमा की तरह लोकहितकर शुभकमे करो, तो इसमें कोई आधये नहीं । हे सुग्रीव ! यह में जानता हूँ कि, तुम सदा ही प्रिय बोला फरते हो

verses.sloka: एवम् त्वयि तत् न चित्रम् भवेत् यत् सौम्य शोभनम् ।जानामि अहम् त्वाम् सुग्रीव सततम् प्रिय वादिनम् ॥४-३९-४॥
verses.transliteration: evam tvayi tat na citram bhavet yat saumya śobhanam ।jānāmi aham tvām sugrīva satatam priya vādinam ॥4-39-4॥

translations.english: 'O gentle Sugriva this your help to me is not surprising. You always help your friends and speak in a pleasing manner.

verses.sloka: त्वत् स नाथः सखे संख्ये जेता अस्मि सकलान् अरीन् ।त्वम् एव मे सुहृत् मित्रम् साहाय्यम् कर्तुम् अर्हसि ॥४-३९-५॥
verses.transliteration: tvat sa nāthaḥ sakhe saṁkhye jetā asmi sakalān arīn ।tvam eva me suhṛt mitram sāhāyyam kartum arhasi ॥4-39-5॥

translations.english: 'O friend I will win over all enemies in war supported by you.You are a goodhearted friend and you alone should help me.
translations.hindi: मुके यह विश्वास हैं कि, तुम्हारे साहाय्य से तो में समस्त शत्तओं को परास्त कर दूँगा । तुम मेरे हितैषी मित्र हो, अतः तुम नेरी मदद करो

verses.sloka: जहार आत्म विनाशाय वैदेहीम् राक्षस अधमः ।वंचयित्वा तु पौलोमीम् अनुह्लादो यथा शचीम् ॥४-३९-६॥
verses.transliteration: jahāra ātma vināśāya vaidehīm rākṣasa adhamaḥ ।vaṁcayitvā tu paulomīm anuhlādo yathā śacīm ॥4-39-6॥

translations.english: Just as Anuhlada (son of Hiranyakasipu and brother of Prahlada) took away, Poulomi (Sachi, daughter of Puloma) deceiving Indra, this lowly demon took away Sita, daughter of the king of Videha.
translations.hindi: जिस प्रकार अनुद्वाद, शची के पिता पौलोमी को धोखा दे शची को हर ले गया था और पीछे इन्द्र द्वारा मारा गया था, उसी प्रकार वह राचसाघम रावण अपना नाश करवाने को सीता जी को हर ले गया है

verses.sloka: न चिरात् तम् हनिष्यामि रावणम् निशितैः शरैः ।पौलोम्याः पितरम् दृप्तम् शत क्रतुः इव अरिहा ॥४-३९-७॥
verses.transliteration: na cirāt tam haniṣyāmi rāvaṇam niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ ।paulomyāḥ pitaram dṛptam śata kratuḥ iva arihā ॥4-39-7॥

translations.english: 'I will kill Ravana with my sharp arrows just as Indra, (who had done a hundred sacrifices) killed the proud father of Poulomi.
translations.hindi: न चिरात्तं हनिष्यामि रावणं निशितैः शरैः । पैलोम्याः पितरं दृप्तं शतक्रतुरिवाहवे ।।७) = किकिग्धाको शत्रहंता इंद्र ने जिस प्रकार शची के हरने वाले ओर हरने की अनुमति देने वाले शची के पिता को, जो बल के गर्व से गर्वित था, मार डाला था, में भी उसी प्रकार शीघ्र पैने बागों से युद्ध में रावण को मार डालूँगा

verses.sloka: एतस्मिन् अन्तरे च एव रजः समभिवर्तत ।उष्णाम् तीव्राम् सहस्रांशोः छादयत् गगने प्रभाम् ॥४-३९-८॥
verses.transliteration: etasmin antare ca eva rajaḥ samabhivartata ।uṣṇām tīvrām sahasrāṁśoḥ chādayat gagane prabhām ॥4-39-8॥

translations.english: In the mean while the dust raised (by army of monkeys) all over obscured the intense heat from the sky and the radiance of the thousandrayed Sun.

verses.sloka: दिशः पर्याकुलाः च आसन् तमसा तेन दूषिताः ।चचाल च मही सर्वा स शैल वन कानना ॥४-३९-९॥
verses.transliteration: diśaḥ paryākulāḥ ca āsan tamasā tena dūṣitāḥ ।cacāla ca mahī sarvā sa śaila vana kānanā ॥4-39-9॥

translations.english: By the spreading of dust, the quarters were not visible.The earth including the mountains gardens and forests was shaken up.

verses.sloka: ततो नगेन्द्र संकाशैः तीक्ष्ण दन्ष्ट्रैः महाबलैः ।कृत्स्ना संछादिता भूमिः असंख्येयैः प्लवंगमैः ॥४-३९-१०॥
verses.transliteration: tato nagendra saṁkāśaiḥ tīkṣṇa danṣṭraiḥ mahābalaiḥ ।kṛtsnā saṁchāditā bhūmiḥ asaṁkhyeyaiḥ plavaṁgamaiḥ ॥4-39-10॥

translations.english: In a minute, the entire land was crowded with innumerable powerful monkeys of the size of mountains having sharp fangs.The monkey leaders with a hundred crore monkey followers, who could assume any form at their will mighty monkeys from the mountains, rivers and seas vanaras thundering like clouds and other free vanaras who were wanderers vanaras red in colour like the rising Sun, tawny coloured ones like the Moon some who were of the hue of white lotus filaments and some vanaras residing in mount Meru came there.
translations.hindi: देखते देखते पहाड़ जेसे विशाल शरीरधारी, पेने पेने दांता वाले और महाबली अगणित वानरों से सारी प्रथिवी ढक जाडे

verses.sloka: निमेष अंतर मात्रेण ततः तैः हरि यूथपैः ।कोटी शत परीवारैः कामरूपिभिः आवृता ॥४-३९-११॥
verses.transliteration: nimeṣa aṁtara mātreṇa tataḥ taiḥ hari yūthapaiḥ ।koṭī śata parīvāraiḥ kāmarūpibhiḥ āvṛtā ॥4-39-11॥

translations.english: In a minute, the entire land was crowded with innumerable powerful monkeys of the size of mountains having sharp fangs.The monkey leaders with a hundred crore monkey followers, who could assume any form at their will mighty monkeys from the mountains, rivers and seas vanaras thundering like clouds and other free vanaras who were wanderers vanaras red in colour like the rising Sun, tawny coloured ones like the Moon some who were of the hue of white lotus filaments and some vanaras residing in mount Meru came there.
translations.hindi: फिर फलक सारते ही इच्छारूपधा री सैकड़ों करोड़ यथनाथ बानरों से एथिवी ढक गई

verses.sloka: नादेयैः पार्वतेयैः च सामुद्रैः च महाबलैः ।हरिभिः मेघ निर्ह्रादैः अन्यैः च वन वासिभिः ॥४-३९-१२॥
verses.transliteration: nādeyaiḥ pārvateyaiḥ ca sāmudraiḥ ca mahābalaiḥ ।haribhiḥ megha nirhrādaiḥ anyaiḥ ca vana vāsibhiḥ ॥4-39-12॥

translations.english: In a minute, the entire land was crowded with innumerable powerful monkeys of the size of mountains having sharp fangs.The monkey leaders with a hundred crore monkey followers, who could assume any form at their will mighty monkeys from the mountains, rivers and seas vanaras thundering like clouds and other free vanaras who were wanderers vanaras red in colour like the rising Sun, tawny coloured ones like the Moon some who were of the hue of white lotus filaments and some vanaras residing in mount Meru came there.
translations.hindi: ये बानरगण नदियों के तदों पर, पवेतों पर, समुद्रों के तर्टो और वनों में रहने वाले और मेघ समान गजेने वाले थे

verses.sloka: तरुण आदित्य वर्णैः च शशि गौरैः च वानरैः ।पद्म केसर वर्णैः च श्वेतैः मेरु कृत आलयैः ॥४-३९-१३॥
verses.transliteration: taruṇa āditya varṇaiḥ ca śaśi gauraiḥ ca vānaraiḥ ।padma kesara varṇaiḥ ca śvetaiḥ meru kṛta ālayaiḥ ॥4-39-13॥

translations.english: In a minute, the entire land was crowded with innumerable powerful monkeys of the size of mountains having sharp fangs.The monkey leaders with a hundred crore monkey followers, who could assume any form at their will mighty monkeys from the mountains, rivers and seas vanaras thundering like clouds and other free vanaras who were wanderers vanaras red in colour like the rising Sun, tawny coloured ones like the Moon some who were of the hue of white lotus filaments and some vanaras residing in mount Meru came there.
translations.hindi: ॥ इनमें कितने ही तरुण सूर्य की तरह लाल रंग के, कितने दी चन्द्रमा की तरह सफेद रंग के, कितने ही कमल-कंसर र (पीले) रंग के थे, ( इनमें से , मेरु पर्वत वासी वानरा का रवत रुग था

verses.sloka: कोटी सहस्रैः दशभिः श्रीमान् परिवृतः तदा ।वीरः शतबलिः नाम वानरः प्रत्यदृश्यत ॥४-३९-१४॥
verses.transliteration: koṭī sahasraiḥ daśabhiḥ śrīmān parivṛtaḥ tadā ।vīraḥ śatabaliḥ nāma vānaraḥ pratyadṛśyata ॥4-39-14॥

translations.english: Then appeared the glorious warrior named Satavali, followed by ten thousand crore of monkeys.
translations.hindi: दख इजार करोड़ वानरों झो साथ जिये हुए, शोभायुक्त शचः बली नामक वीर वानर देख १ड़ा

verses.sloka: ततः कांचन शैल आभः ताराया वीर्यवान् पिता ।अनेकैः बहु साहस्रैः कोटिभिः प्रत्यदृश्यत ॥४-३९-१५॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kāṁcana śaila ābhaḥ tārāyā vīryavān pitā ।anekaiḥ bahu sāhasraiḥ koṭibhiḥ pratyadṛśyata ॥4-39-15॥

translations.english: (Next came) the valiant father of Tara of golden complexion like mount Meru followed by ten thousand crore of vanaras.

verses.sloka: तथा अपरेण कोटीनाम् साहस्रेण समन्वितः ।पिता रुमयाः संप्राप्तः सुग्रीव श्वशुरो विभुः ॥४-३९-१६॥
verses.transliteration: tathā apareṇa koṭīnām sāhasreṇa samanvitaḥ ।pitā rumayāḥ saṁprāptaḥ sugrīva śvaśuro vibhuḥ ॥4-39-16॥

translations.english: Likewise mighty father of Ruma, fatherinlaw of Sugriva, reached there accompanied by a thousand crore monkeys.
translations.hindi: तद्नन्तर गोलांगूल ( गौ जैसी पूंड वाले ) वंदरो के महाराज ओर भोस पराक्रमी गवाक्ष नामक वानर एक हजार करोड़ बानरों को साथ लिये वहाँ आए

verses.sloka: पद्म केसर संकाशः तरुण अर्क निभ आननः ।बुद्धिमान् वानर श्रेष्ठः सर्व वानर सत्तमः ॥४-३९-१७॥
verses.transliteration: padma kesara saṁkāśaḥ taruṇa arka nibha ānanaḥ ।buddhimān vānara śreṣṭhaḥ sarva vānara sattamaḥ ॥4-39-17॥

translations.english: Then arrived Kesari, the wise and illustrious monkey, foremost and the best among vanaras, father of Hanuman. He was of the colour of lotus filaments and his countenance was red like the early morning Sun. He was accompanied by many thousands of monkeys.

verses.sloka: अनीकैः बहु साहस्रैः वानराणाम् समन्वितः ।पिता हनुमतः श्रीमान् केसरी प्रत्यदृश्यत ॥४-३९-१८॥
verses.transliteration: anīkaiḥ bahu sāhasraiḥ vānarāṇām samanvitaḥ ।pitā hanumataḥ śrīmān kesarī pratyadṛśyata ॥4-39-18॥

translations.english: Then arrived Kesari, the wise and illustrious monkey, foremost and the best among vanaras, father of Hanuman. He was of the colour of lotus filaments and his countenance was red like the early morning Sun. He was accompanied by many thousands of monkeys.

verses.sloka: गो लांगूल महाराजो गवाक्षो भीम विक्रमः ।वृतः कोटि सहस्रेण वानराणाम् अदृश्यत ॥४-३९-१९॥
verses.transliteration: go lāṁgūla mahārājo gavākṣo bhīma vikramaḥ ।vṛtaḥ koṭi sahasreṇa vānarāṇām adṛśyata ॥4-39-19॥

translations.english: Next arrived Gavaksha, king of Langurs (whose tail resembled the cow's), of fierceful courage surrounded by a thousand crore of vanaras.

verses.sloka: ऋक्षाणाम् भीम वेगानाम् धूम्रः शत्रु निबर्हणः ।वृतः कोटि सहस्राभ्याम् द्वाभ्याम् समभिवर्तत ॥४-३९-२०॥
verses.transliteration: ṛkṣāṇām bhīma vegānām dhūmraḥ śatru nibarhaṇaḥ ।vṛtaḥ koṭi sahasrābhyām dvābhyām samabhivartata ॥4-39-20॥

translations.english: Dhumra, destroyer of enemies, came next followed by two thousand crore of bears of terrible speed.

verses.sloka: महा अचल निभैः घोरैः पनसो नाम यूथपः ।आजगाम महावीर्यः तिसृभिः कोटिभिः वृतः ॥४-३९-२१॥
verses.transliteration: mahā acala nibhaiḥ ghoraiḥ panaso nāma yūthapaḥ ।ājagāma mahāvīryaḥ tisṛbhiḥ koṭibhiḥ vṛtaḥ ॥4-39-21॥

translations.english: Similarly, the great warrior named Panasa, leader of the troop, reported with three crore dreadful vanaras of the size of huge mountains.

verses.sloka: नील अंजन चय आकारो नीलो नाम अथ यूथपः ।अदृश्यत महाकायः कोटिभिः दशभिः वृतः ॥४-३९-२२॥
verses.transliteration: nīla aṁjana caya ākāro nīlo nāma atha yūthapaḥ ।adṛśyata mahākāyaḥ koṭibhiḥ daśabhiḥ vṛtaḥ ॥4-39-22॥

translations.english: Then appeared Nila of huge body, dark like a mountain of collyrium accompanied by ten crore vanaras.
translations.hindi: नीलपबत की तरह विशाल वपुधारी नील नामक यूथपति, दस करोड़ वानरों को ले कर उपस्थित हुए

verses.sloka: ततः कांचन आभो गवयो नाम यूथपः ।आजगाम महावीर्यः कोटिभिः पंचभिः वृतः ॥४-३९-२३॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kāṁcana ābho gavayo nāma yūthapaḥ ।ājagāma mahāvīryaḥ koṭibhiḥ paṁcabhiḥ vṛtaḥ ॥4-39-23॥

translations.english: Then arrived the leader of five crore vanaras, the great warrior Gavaya who resembled a golden mountain.
translations.hindi: पाँच करोड़ वानरों को लिए हुए, सुबर्ण पवेत की तरह आति वाले महाबली गवय नामक यूथपति उपस्थित हुए

verses.sloka: दरीमुखः च बलवान् यूथपो अभ्याययौ तदा ।वृतः कोटि सहस्रेण सुग्रीवम् समुपस्थितः ॥४-३९-२४॥
verses.transliteration: darīmukhaḥ ca balavān yūthapo abhyāyayau tadā ।vṛtaḥ koṭi sahasreṇa sugrīvam samupasthitaḥ ॥4-39-24॥

translations.english: Then the strong Darimukha, leader of a thousand crore monkeys approached Sugriva.
translations.hindi: एक सहस्र कोटि वानरें की सेना साथ लिए हुए, दरी- सुख नामक बलवान्‌ यूथपति सुग्रीव के समीप आ कर उपम्धिन् हुए

verses.sloka: मैन्दः च द्विविदः च उभौ अश्वि पुत्रौ महाबलौ ।कोटि कोटि सहस्रेण वानराणाम् अदृश्यताम् ॥४-३९-२५॥
verses.transliteration: maindaḥ ca dvividaḥ ca ubhau aśvi putrau mahābalau ।koṭi koṭi sahasreṇa vānarāṇām adṛśyatām ॥4-39-25॥

translations.english: Two very powerful sons of Asvini, Mainda and Dvivida, appeared with a thousand crore vanaras.

verses.sloka: गजः च बलवान् वीरः त्रिसृभिः कोटिभिः वृतः ।आजगाम महातेजाः सुग्रीवस्य समीपतः ॥४-३९-२६॥
verses.transliteration: gajaḥ ca balavān vīraḥ trisṛbhiḥ koṭibhiḥ vṛtaḥ ।ājagāma mahātejāḥ sugrīvasya samīpataḥ ॥4-39-26॥

translations.english: Strong and powerful Gaja also reached Sugriva with three crore vanaras.
translations.hindi: बलवान्‌ वीर गज, तीन करोड़ वानरों को साथ ले कर सुत्रीव के पास उपस्थित हुए

verses.sloka: ऋक्ष राजो महातेजा जांबवान् नाम नामतः ।कोटिभिः दशभिः व्याप्तः सुग्रीवस्य वशे स्थितः ॥४-३९-२७॥
verses.transliteration: ṛkṣa rājo mahātejā jāṁbavān nāma nāmataḥ ।koṭibhiḥ daśabhiḥ vyāptaḥ sugrīvasya vaśe sthitaḥ ॥4-39-27॥

translations.english: Glorious Jambavan, king of bears, stood before Sugriva with ten thousand crore vanaras.

verses.sloka: रुमणो नाम तेजस्वी विक्रान्तैः वानरैः वृतः ।आगतो बलवान् तूर्णम् कोटि शत समावृतः ॥४-३९-२८॥
verses.transliteration: rumaṇo nāma tejasvī vikrāntaiḥ vānaraiḥ vṛtaḥ ।āgato balavān tūrṇam koṭi śata samāvṛtaḥ ॥4-39-28॥

translations.english: Sturdy and victorious vanara called Rumanvan came swiftly followed by a hundred crore vanaras.

verses.sloka: ततः कोटि सहस्राणाम् सहस्रेण शतेन च ।पृष्ठतो अनुगतः प्राप्तो हरिभिः गंधमादनः ॥४-३९-२९॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ koṭi sahasrāṇām sahasreṇa śatena ca ।pṛṣṭhato anugataḥ prāpto haribhiḥ gaṁdhamādanaḥ ॥4-39-29॥

translations.english: Then came Gandhamadana with a hundred thousand crore of vanaras following him.

verses.sloka: ततः पद्म सहस्रेण वृतः शन्कु शतेन च ।युव राजो अंगदः प्राप्तः पितृ तुल्य पराक्रमः ॥४-३९-३०॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ padma sahasreṇa vṛtaḥ śanku śatena ca ।yuva rājo aṁgadaḥ prāptaḥ pitṛ tulya parākramaḥ ॥4-39-30॥

translations.english: Then arrived the heir apparent, Angada, whose prowess is comparable to that of his father with him came a thousand padmas and a hundred sankus of followers.
translations.hindi: अपने पिता बालि की तरह पराक्रमी युवराज अङ्गद, एक हजार पद्म और एक हज़ार शङ्क बदरों झो साथ लिए हुए देख पड़े

verses.sloka: ततः तारा द्युतिः तारो हरिः भीम पराक्रमः ।पंचभिः हरि कोटीभिः दूरतः प्रत्यदृश्यत ॥४-३९-३१॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ tārā dyutiḥ tāro hariḥ bhīma parākramaḥ ।paṁcabhiḥ hari koṭībhiḥ dūrataḥ pratyadṛśyata ॥4-39-31॥

translations.english: And Tara (brother of Ruma's father) of terrific valour shining like a star showed up at a distance with five crore vanaras.
translations.hindi: तारा की तरह द्युतिमान्‌ तार नामक यूथपति पाँच करोड़ बानरी सेना के साथ दूर से आते हुए देख पड़े

verses.sloka: इन्द्रजानुः कपिः वीरो यूथपः प्रत्यदृश्यत ।एकादशानाम् कोटीनाम् ईश्वरः तैः च सम्वृतः ॥४-३९-३२॥
verses.transliteration: indrajānuḥ kapiḥ vīro yūthapaḥ pratyadṛśyata ।ekādaśānām koṭīnām īśvaraḥ taiḥ ca samvṛtaḥ ॥4-39-32॥

translations.english: Then Indrajanu the troop leader and chief of vanaras appeared along with eleven crore monkeys.
translations.hindi: ग्यारह करोंड़ वानरो को साथ लिए हुए वीरवर कपियुथ- इन्द्रजाल आते देख पड़े

verses.sloka: ततो रंभः तु अनुप्राप्तः तरुण आदित्य संनिभः ।आयुतेन वृतः चैव सहस्रेण शतेन च ॥४-३९-३३॥
verses.transliteration: tato raṁbhaḥ tu anuprāptaḥ taruṇa āditya saṁnibhaḥ ।āyutena vṛtaḥ caiva sahasreṇa śatena ca ॥4-39-33॥

translations.english: Thereafter Rambha of the colour of the rising Sun brought together an army of one thousand and one hundred ayuta troops.

verses.sloka: ततो यूथ पतिः वीरो दुर्मुखो नाम वानरः ।प्रत्यदृश्यत कोटिभ्याम् द्वाभ्याम् परिवृतो बली ॥४-३९-३४॥
verses.transliteration: tato yūtha patiḥ vīro durmukho nāma vānaraḥ ।pratyadṛśyata koṭibhyām dvābhyām parivṛto balī ॥4-39-34॥

translations.english: Thereafter the mighty hero, leader of the troop, by name Durmukha appeared with two crore vanaras.
translations.hindi: ढुमुख नामक वीर यूथपति वानर, दो करोड़ बंदरों को ज्ञिये हुए आते देख

verses.sloka: कैलास शिखर आकारैः वानरैः भीम विक्रमैः ।वृतः कोटि सहस्रेण हनुमान् प्रत्यदृश्यत ॥४-३९-३५॥
verses.transliteration: kailāsa śikhara ākāraiḥ vānaraiḥ bhīma vikramaiḥ ।vṛtaḥ koṭi sahasreṇa hanumān pratyadṛśyata ॥4-39-35॥

translations.english: And Hanuman showed up surrounded by a thousand crore vanaras of frightful valour. They looked like the peaks of Kailasa mountain.
translations.hindi: कैलासशिखर की तरह विशाल शरीर धारी भयङ्कर पराक्रम वाले हनुमान जो सहस्र करोड़ वानरों को साथ ले उपस्थित हुए

verses.sloka: नलः च अपि महावीर्यः संवृतो द्रुम वासिभिः ।कोटी शतेन संप्राप्तः सहस्रेण शतेन च ॥४-३९-३६॥
verses.transliteration: nalaḥ ca api mahāvīryaḥ saṁvṛto druma vāsibhiḥ ।koṭī śatena saṁprāptaḥ sahasreṇa śatena ca ॥4-39-36॥

translations.english: Valiant Nala also arrived surrounded by a hundred crore and a hundred thousand treedwellers (monkeys).
translations.hindi: फिर महाबली नल नामक यूथनाथ, पेड़ों पर रहने चाले सौ करोड़ एक हज़ार वानरों को सेना साथ लिये हुए आये

verses.sloka: ततो दधिमुखः श्रीमान् कोटिभिः दशभिः वृतः ।संप्राप्तो अभिनदन् तस्य सुग्रीवस्य महात्मनः ॥४-३९-३७॥
verses.transliteration: tato dadhimukhaḥ śrīmān koṭibhiḥ daśabhiḥ vṛtaḥ ।saṁprāpto abhinadan tasya sugrīvasya mahātmanaḥ ॥4-39-37॥

translations.english: Then the illustrious Dadhimukha, great Sugriva's favourite leader reached with ten crore vanaras.

verses.sloka: शरभः कुमुदो वह्निः वानरो रंहः एव च ।एते च अन्ये च बहवो वानराः काम रूपिणः ॥४-३९-३८॥
verses.transliteration: śarabhaḥ kumudo vahniḥ vānaro raṁhaḥ eva ca ।ete ca anye ca bahavo vānarāḥ kāma rūpiṇaḥ ॥4-39-38॥

translations.english: Sarabha, Kumuda, Vahni and Ramhi and many other vanara troops who can assume any form at their will and others from all over the land, mountains and forest advanced towards Sugriva. All the outstanding vanaras of the earth came and covered the land.

verses.sloka: आवृत्य पृथिवीम् सर्वाम् पर्वतान् च वनानि च ।यूथपाः समनुप्राप्ता एषाम् संख्या न विद्यते ॥४-३९-३९॥
verses.transliteration: āvṛtya pṛthivīm sarvām parvatān ca vanāni ca ।yūthapāḥ samanuprāptā eṣām saṁkhyā na vidyate ॥4-39-39॥

translations.english: Sarabha, Kumuda, Vahni and Ramhi and many other vanara troops who can assume any form at their will and others from all over the land, mountains and forest advanced towards Sugriva. All the outstanding vanaras of the earth came and covered the land.

verses.sloka: आगताः च निविष्टाः च पृथिव्याम् सर्व वानराः ।आप्लवंतः प्लवंतः च गर्जंतः च प्लवंगमाः ।अभ्यवर्तन्त सुग्रीवम् सूर्यम् अभ्र गणा इव ॥४-३९-४०॥
verses.transliteration: āgatāḥ ca niviṣṭāḥ ca pṛthivyām sarva vānarāḥ ।āplavaṁtaḥ plavaṁtaḥ ca garjaṁtaḥ ca plavaṁgamāḥ ।abhyavartanta sugrīvam sūryam abhra gaṇā iva ॥4-39-40॥

translations.english: The monkeys came leaping, jumping and roaring in enthusiasm and surrounded Sugriva just as clouds surround the Sun.
translations.hindi: । आगताश्च विशिष्टाश्‍च पृथिव्यां सर्ववानराः । झाणुबन्तः पुवन्तरच गजन्तश्च पुवडुमा! ४०१ प्रथिवी पर जो मुख्य मुख्य वानर थे, वे सब उछलते बु रते किलकारियां मारते सुम्नोब के पास आ पहुँचे

verses.sloka: कुर्वाणा बहु शब्दान् च प्रकृष्टा बलशालिनः ।शिरोभिः वानरेन्द्राय सुग्रीवाय न्यवेदयन् ॥४-३९-४१॥
verses.transliteration: kurvāṇā bahu śabdān ca prakṛṣṭā balaśālinaḥ ।śirobhiḥ vānarendrāya sugrīvāya nyavedayan ॥4-39-41॥

translations.english: The leaders of monkeys possesing sturdy shoulders made many kinds of noises and reported to Sugriva, bending their heads in reverence.
translations.hindi: अभ्यवतन्त सुग्रीवं सूय॑मश्रगणा इव । कुवोणा बहुशब्दांश्चकप्रकृष्ठा बलशालिनः ॥४१) और चारों ओर से सुग्रीव को ऐसे घेर लिया जैसे बादल सूयं को घेर लेते हैँ । आए हुए प्रकृष्ट बलशाली वानर अनेक प्रकार की बोलियाँ बोल रहे थे

verses.sloka: अपरे वानर श्रेष्ठाः संगम्य च यथा उचितम् ।सुग्रीवेण समागम्य स्थिताः प्रांजलयः तदा ॥४-३९-४२॥
verses.transliteration: apare vānara śreṣṭhāḥ saṁgamya ca yathā ucitam ।sugrīveṇa samāgamya sthitāḥ prāṁjalayaḥ tadā ॥4-39-42॥

translations.english: Thereafter the vanaras came close to Sugriva freely and on reaching him stood, offering salutations with folded hands.
translations.hindi: टिप्पणी-सुम्रीव द्वारा किए गए इस वानरी सैन्य-संग्रह से यह अवगत होता हे कि किष्किन्धाराज्य में भी सामन्त-प्रथा प्रचलित थी | ! # पाठान्तरे “ प्रहृष्टा ” | पकोनचत्वारिंशः सर्यः ३८ शिरो भिर्वानरेन्द्राय सुग्रीवाय न्यवेदयन्‌ । अपरे वानरश्रेष्ठा; «यस्य च यथोचितम्‌ ॥ सुग्रीवेश समागम्य स्थिताः प्राजजलयस्तदा

verses.sloka: सुग्रीवः त्वरितो रामे सर्वान् तान् वानरर्षभान् ।निवेदयित्वा धर्मज्ञः स्थितः प्रान्जलिः अब्रवीत् ॥४-३९-४३॥
verses.transliteration: sugrīvaḥ tvarito rāme sarvān tān vānararṣabhān ।nivedayitvā dharmajñaḥ sthitaḥ prānjaliḥ abravīt ॥4-39-43॥

translations.english: Sugriva, knower of dharma, at once presented all the prominent vanaras to Rama, and standing with folded hands said.
translations.hindi: तदनन्तर सुम्रीड ने, तुरन्त ही धर्मज्ञ श्रीरामचन्द्र जी को उन सब वानरों का आगमन हाथ जोड़ कर निवेदन किआ और फिर बानर-युथपतियों से कहा

verses.sloka: यथा सुखम् पर्वत निर्झरेषुवनेषु सर्वेषु च वानरेन्द्राः ।निवेशयित्वा विधिवत् बलानिबलम् बलज्ञः प्रतिपत्तुम् ईष्टे ॥४-३९-४४॥
verses.transliteration: yathā sukham parvata nirjhareṣuvaneṣu sarveṣu ca vānarendrāḥ ।niveśayitvā vidhivat balānibalam balajñaḥ pratipattum īṣṭe ॥4-39-44॥

translations.english: Sugriva told the chiefs to station the forces by the side of swift mountain streams, in forests, and hills and ascertain their exact number. इत्यार्ष श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे एकोनचत्वारिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the thirtyninth sarga of Kishkindakanda of the first epic, the Holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
